questions.text: How many vertices does a cube have?
questions.explanation: A cube has 8 corners, which are called vertices.

questions.text: Which of the following is a 2D representation of a 3D object?
questions.explanation: A net is a 2D skeleton outline that can be folded to form a 3D shape.

questions.text: How many faces does a triangular pyramid have?
questions.explanation: A triangular pyramid (tetrahedron) has 1 base and 3 side faces, making a total of 4 faces.
